snippet.title: Deluxe Invaders for the Atari 8-bit family
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

???


Game description:

Deluxe Invaders is a clone of the popular Arcade hit "Space Invaders".

You can play either alone or with another player.


What I think:

Quite fun, but damn this game goes insanely fast.
